quests.title: Saying Hello
quests.summary: Hotaru is waiting to hear you. Make a print block or write Python to say "Hello, Hotaru!". Test, then Speak. Your first steps follow naturally.
lesson: Your first program gives you a voice. Hotaru says: "Try saying hello to me!"
print sends text out of your program. Quotation marks tell Python these are words to say.

Blocks make the same real Python. Test watches it run; Speak makes your words part of the room. Once Hotaru hears your greeting, she introduces Field Notes / 01 and opens the page for your first steps.
hints: Put your words between quotation marks: print("Hello, Hotaru!").
Say hello and use Hotaru’s name, then Test and Speak.
quests.done: Hotaru: "I can hear you! Now let’s give those feet a little direction."

quests.title: Make the keys your own
quests.summary: Write one step for each key. Test the movement in your notebook, Apply, then try all four directions in your room.
lesson: A key press is an event. Each event starts with x = y = 0; your arithmetic adds a movement.
In Blocks, choose an axis and += or -=, then change the amount. Try 0, 1 and 3 and compare the little room. See Python shows the real program the blocks produce.
x += 1 goes east ↘; x -= 1 goes west ↖. y += 1 goes north ↗; y -= 1 goes south ↙.
Test runs the real Python in a copy of your room. Green marks one step; red shows a stationary character, an overshoot or an invalid move. The test does not count as practice.
Apply connects the tested keys. Close the notebook, then try each direction once in your real room.
starter: # One key press adds one step. Test, then Apply.
# Start each key's x and y at zero.
hints: Each event begins at x = y = 0. An amount of 0 stays still; 3 overshoots. Test them to see why.
Try W: y += 1, A: x -= 1, S: y -= 1, D: x += 1. See Python shows the generated code.
After Test and Apply, close the notebook and take a successful step in every direction. The mini-room and clicks do not count as practice.
quests.done: Your keys are connected, and you have tried every direction. Hotaru is ready to follow you into the lane.
